certification_boundary: This run certifies one internally accessed Multi-Agent Quickstart seat created from the final deployed catalog contract, made ready without a retry or live patch, functionally exercised, namespace-isolated, and reclaimed through Launchpad on Arena. It does not certify public-code access, five seats, twenty-five seats, durable external image storage, or general availability.

capacity_preview.placement_reason: Entire workshop assigned to arena; seats will not be split

launchpad_validation.repeatability_note: The current report computes handoff_generated from live session status, so its score falls from 100 to 80 after successful reclaim; the five platform checks and handoff fields were captured independently.

red_green_matrix.red: The first live run required an image correction, a readiness correction, and an explicit validation retry.
red_green_matrix.green: A new Launchpad order from the final deployed contract reached ready on its first provisioning attempt in 41.58 seconds without a retry or live resource patch.

red_green_matrix.red: Catalog source and pod readiness alone did not prove inference, A2A coordination, MCP enrichment, semantic routing, or guardrail denial.
red_green_matrix.green: The reusable live driver proved three model-backed agent steps, MCP data in all steps, successful semantic routing, and guardrail denial for all three agents.

red_green_matrix.red: A running terminal did not prove the seat identity was confined to its assigned namespace.
red_green_matrix.green: The terminal could edit the assigned namespace while cross-namespace access and node listing were denied.

red_green_matrix.red: A ready seat did not prove that workshop reclaim removed its distributed resources and revoked its model key.
red_green_matrix.green: Reclaim completed in 63 seconds with zero labeled namespaces, Applications, RoleBindings, PVCs, PVs, Routes, or Secrets and a cleared model key.

test_strategy.TDD: The clean-run evidence and promotion contract first failed because the evidence artifact did not exist and the catalog still identified a runtime candidate.
test_strategy.EDD: This hashed artifact records immutable commits and image digests, lifecycle identifiers and timestamps, participant-facing probes, functional AI behavior, authorization denials, and labeled-resource cleanup evidence.
test_strategy.CDD: The deployed backend consumed the repository onboarding contract and generated the same Helm identity, runtime Secret, route, model, and cleanup contracts exercised live.
test_strategy.BDD: Given one internal Multi-Agent seat targeted to Arena, when the final catalog contract is confirmed, then it becomes ready without intervention, the participant can complete a coordinated model-backed journey, the terminal remains namespace-confined, and reclaim leaves zero labeled residue.
test_strategy.CBT: Image construction, Helm rendering, readiness, UI, A2A, MCP, semantic routing, guardrails, RBAC, Secret handling, Argo state, Launchpad lifecycle, and cleanup were proven independently and together.
